name: specstream
title: SpecStream
description: Ask for data in plain words and get structured results from the live web. Requires a SpecStream account and API key.
author: specstreamai

commands.name: start-find
commands.title: Request Data
commands.description: Describe the data you need in plain words, see the most it can cost, and approve it before it runs.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your SpecStream API key. Create one under Agents and API in your workspace. Its permissions and spending limit apply in Raycast too.

preferences.name: apiOrigin
preferences.title: API Origin
preferences.description: Where SpecStream runs. Leave the default unless support asks you to change it.
